steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Dangers of the Deep
steps.body:
A lad named Brannick once told me dungeons were 'basically caves with loot.' We found his shield on floor two. We did not find Brannick.

Heroes who fall in combat are gone. Permanently. No resurrection, no refunds.

If someone goes down mid-fight, you can flee — but survivors drop ALL their equipment and bag items in the panic. Every sword, every potion, gone. Sometimes retreat costs more than the fight.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: The Shopkeeper's Edge
steps.body:
Your shopkeeper bag is the one thing the dungeon can't take. Flee, wipe, total catastrophe — whatever's in that bag comes home.

Stash anything valuable there as you go. After the last room on a floor, you can Extract to bank everything safely back to town.

Brannick didn't have a shopkeeper. You do. Use that advantage.
